title: THE FOUR OLDS audio play — a01_cold_open

lines.sfx: ATMOS studio | a broadcast desk tone holds, a low room hum under it.
FX | a wall of monitors flips the board over with one hard electronic snap.
FX | soft rubber taps scatter down across the desk mics.
FX | a wet swallow catches off the studio mic.
CUT | broadcast static swells and the feed switches over.
ATMOS arena | a full hall roars and a big-room PA hums under all of it.
FX | the crowd finds a rhythm and chants, history is healing, history is healing.
CUT | the feed cuts back on a burst of static.
ATMOS studio | the desk tone returns with the room hum under it.
CUT | static rides the switch to a new feed.
ATMOS cargobay | a drone rotor whines out over a wide concrete bay.
CUT | the feed switches under a wash of static.
ATMOS brussels | a signing room murmurs and glassware clinks close by.
FX | a champagne cork pops and a glass is filled.
CUT | static, and the feed opens on a quiet room.
ATMOS hearing | a hearing room settles and a microphone hums close.
FX | the witness microphone holds an open hum and nothing comes back into it.
CUT | the broadcast thins down into a small tinny counter speaker.
ATMOS diner | a griddle hisses low and morning crockery settles along the counter.
FX | a coffee pot works its way down the counter and a cup is topped off without asking.
FX | a cup turns a quarter turn on its saucer.
FX | he drinks and sets the cup back down on the saucer.
FX | a hand clicks the radio off in the middle of a word.
ATMOS diner | the griddle hisses on alone and nothing else moves.
FX | a long quiet settles over the counter.
MUSIC | the show's theme rises.
